title: 각종분쟁조정위원회등의조정조서등에대한집행문부여에관한규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:5:0:00005:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 5 (Receipt, Management and Retention of Applications)
(1) An application for granting a writ of execution shall be received by entering it in the register of document case titles of the division responsible for civil execution affairs.
(2) Applications and related documents shall be arranged in the order of receipt and managed in the file entitled "Applications for Granting Writs of Execution on Mediation Records, etc. of Various Dispute Resolution Committees, etc."
(3) Chapter VI of the Rules on Handling Court Adjudication Affairs shall apply mutatis mutandis to the retention of applications and related documents. <Amended on July 6, 1998.>
